title: Sprint 4 — JavaScript Fundamentals
description: Learn the essential mechanics of JavaScript to add logic and interactive behavior to your web applications.

tickets.title: Ticket 1 — JS Language Core
tickets.description: Grasp the foundational concepts of programming in JavaScript, including managing data, writing reusable logic, and processing collections.

tasks.title: Task 4.1.1 — Variables, Types & Coercion
tasks.description: Understand how to store data and accurately compare values to ensure your logic runs flawlessly.

tasks.title: Task 4.1.2 — Functions: Declaration, Expression & Arrow
tasks.description: Explore different ways to package logic into reusable functions for cleaner code.

tasks.title: Task 4.1.3 — Arrays & Higher-Order Functions
tasks.description: Process and transform lists of data, making it easy to display exactly what the user needs.

tasks.title: Task 4.1.4 — Objects, Destructuring & Spread
tasks.description: Utilize modern JavaScript techniques to extract and manipulate data from complex structures efficiently.

tickets.title: Ticket 2 — DOM Manipulation
tickets.description: Bridge the gap between your logic and the user interface. You will learn to update the page dynamically and respond to user actions.

tasks.title: Task 4.2.1 — Selecting & Modifying the DOM
tasks.description: Gain the ability to dynamically update the content and structure of your web pages.

tasks.title: Task 4.2.2 — Event Listeners & Event Delegation
tasks.description: Create interactive lists that efficiently manage user interactions, even as new items are added.
tasks.method: In-Browser DOM Assertion Engine + Synthetic Events (Method 1)

tasks.title: Task 4.2.3 — Form Validation with DOM
tasks.description: Ensure data quality and improve user experience by validating form inputs as users type.
tasks.method: In-Browser DOM Assertion Engine + Synthetic Events (Method 1)

tasks.title: Task 4.2.4 — Dynamic Content Rendering
tasks.description: Populate your user interface automatically based on underlying data collections.
